channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Mountain Dew unveils a spicy new Baja drink– But there's a catch
item.description: Mountain Dew has introduced Baja Leo Zero Sugar, a limited-edition flavour combining spiced mango, chilli lime and black pepper. The exclusive release will be available via TikTok Shop from 12 August while supplies last.

item.title: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke blasts Supreme Court’s comment on TMC MP Mahua Moitra’s ‘fear of eggs’
item.description: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke criticised the Supreme Court's remarks about TMC MP Mahua Moitra's concerns over potential egg-throwing incidents.

item.title: Will schools be closed tomorrow, August 8? Check IMD's heavy rainfall warnings for your state
item.description: The IMD's latest weather bulletin has flagged severe rain warnings for multiple regions, including parts of Delhi-NCR, Kerala, and Odisha

item.title: Jharkhand students protest: JPSC-JSSC Reforms Manch announces march to state assembly on Monday if demands not met
item.description: The first round of talks between the government and a 10-member delegation of the JPSC/JSSC Reforms Manch was held here on Friday evening. The Manch leaders said they would march to the state assembly on August 10 if their demands were not met by Sunday

item.title: Woman arrested after ₹258 crore online order cancellations caused seller huge loss: 'Placing them satisfied my desire'
item.description: Yoshida selected cash on delivery as the payment option but never completed the purchases. In many instances, she refused to accept the parcels when they arrived, while some orders were cancelled before they were dispatched.

item.title: E20 petrol meets quality standards, say OMCs citing new tests
item.description: OMCs say they have further strengthened surveillance by conducting water ingress and density tests 8–12 times daily at every retail outlet.

item.title: BRICS focuses on open markets, cash-flow lending and MSME expansion at Jaipur summit
item.description: The Jaipur Consensus introduces cash-flow credit assessment for MSMEs to help narrow a $2.5-trillion global trade finance gap, alongside a 2026–2030 action plan for supply chain resilience in critical sectors.

item.title: NEET paper leak masterminds used ‘FIFA World Cup 2026’ WhatsApp group: Secret chats play major role in CBI crackdown
item.description: The CBI uncovered a NEET-UG paper leak conspiracy through mobile forensic investigations, leading to several arrests across multiple states.&nbsp;

item.title: Trump’s $400 million White House ballroom project put on hold — ‘Not ceded unfettered to fit President’s desires…’
item.description: The appeals court placed its ruling on hold for 14 days to allow the Trump administration to appeal to the US Supreme Court.

item.title: Trump accuses Congress of seeking to regulate AI industry ‘out of business’ after Open AI, Anthropic security incidents
item.description: Trump’s comments come as Washington grapples with how far the federal government should go in regulating the rapidly developing AI sector, which has largely operated without new federal rules. Lawmakers have introduced several regulatory proposals, though none have advanced significantly.

item.title: Delhi-NCR rain: Internet reacts as flooding, traffic chaos bring region to a standstill | Watch video
item.description: The IMD has issued a red alert for Delhi-NCR, with rain expected to continue on Friday. Gurugram remains severely affected by waterlogging after receiving nearly 97 mm of rainfall, with authorities warning of traffic disruption and localised flooding.

item.title: Can India revoke Meta's safe harbour protection? Why Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp are under scrutiny
item.description: Meta's safe harbour protection is under scrutiny after a parliamentary panel questioned the temporary restriction of PM Narendra Modi's Facebook post. Here's what safe harbour means, whether India can revoke it and what it could mean for Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp.

item.title: William Orbit, Grammy-winning producer, dies at 69
item.description: Grammy-winning British producer William Orbit has died aged 69. His family announced the news on Instagram, paying tribute to the acclaimed musician whose work with Madonna, Blur, U2 and others helped redefine modern pop and electronic music.

item.title: Will it rain in Delhi tomorrow? IMD warns of downpour in several states under ‘influence of low-pressure area’
item.description: A low-pressure system over southwest Uttar Pradesh and neighbouring areas has resulted in heavy rainfall over the national capital.

item.title: ₹12 lakh for government job: Delhi Police exposes massive recruitment exam scam involving ChatGPT
item.description: Delhi Police revealed an interstate cheating racket led by a firefighter from Chandigarh that used AI tools to aid candidates in government exams.&nbsp;

item.title: US employers unexpectedly shed jobs, unemployment rate falls
item.description: Nonfarm payrolls decreased 23,000 last month following a combined 103,000 downward revision to the May and June figures, Bureau of Labor Statistics data showed

item.title: Will Trump’s 2026 ‘Birth Tourism’ orders impact Indian H-1B visa holders? Here's what we know
item.description: Since an H-1B or L-1 worker is authorised to live in the US primarily for specialised employment—and an F-1 student for education—they do not fit the administration's operational definition of a “birth tourist”. However, policy experts urge caution.

item.title: Strait of Hormuz framework agreed with Oman, says Iranian official amid US-Iran war: When will it completely reopen?
item.description: An Iranian official said that a framework regarding the Strait of Hormuz has been agreed with Oman. It remains uncertain whether Iran’s Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei has approved the proposal, which is required for the agreement to move forward.

item.title: Netizens find something ‘wrong’ with Rahul Gandhi’s warning about E20 petrol, ‘Daal me kuchh kaala hai’
item.description: Rahul Gandhi warns the Modi government about the E20 petrol issue, claiming it harms vehicles and disrupts lives. Social media users have criticised his video; here's why.

item.title: Total Solar Eclipse 2026: Rare celestial event to sweep Northern Hemisphere, but will India witness it?
item.description: A rare total solar eclipse will cross parts of the Northern Hemisphere on August 12, 2026, bringing totality to Greenland, Iceland, Spain and Portugal. India will not witness the event, while experts urge safe viewing practices.

item.title: ‘Just bihar things’: Man with fractured leg gets cardboard support; social media reacts to viral video
item.description: A man with a fractured leg at a Bihar government hospital received only cardboard as support due to a lack of plaster. This incident, captured in a viral video, sparked outrage, with critics highlighting the poor state of healthcare in the region despite significant investments.

item.title: Video: Three schoolchildren fall into hidden drain amid Delhi rain, rescued by locals
item.description: Three schoolchildren were rescued after falling into a drain hidden beneath floodwater in Delhi's Jagatpur, with the incident captured on CCTV. The mishap came as heavy rain triggered waterlogging across the city and the IMD issued a red alert.

item.title: ‘Even the US’ regulates foreign funding: India hits back at Republican lawmaker's remarks – 'Our Parliament decides'
item.description: Various countries, including the United States, enforce regulations on foreign monetary inflows, the Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) said.

item.title: Atiq Ahmad's son's friend describes horrifying experience before SUV crash in Jhansi that killed 2. What did he allege?
item.description: Aban Ahmad was the youngest son of slain gangster-turned-politician Atiq Ahmad. His 25-year-old friend Sonu, son of Raja, also died in the Jhansi accident. ‘The car was travelling at a high speed, and the driver lost control,’ Umar, friend of Aban, said.

item.title: CJP backs Jharkhand students' protest, says 'We don't want credit'; Abhijeet Dipke plans visit
item.description: CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke backed the Jharkhand students' protest, saying the party had sent a delegation to support demonstrators but did not want credit for the movement. He also endorsed RSS chief Mohan Bhagwat's remarks defending student protests.

item.title: Bombay HC to decide on FSSAI rum sales ban on Monday
item.description: The FSSAI has banned the sale of many variants or rum, particularly Old Monk, &nbsp;over the use of rum flavouring.

item.title: IMD warns of extremely heavy rain in east India, flood risk in Odisha, Jharkhand
item.description: Dual low-pressure systems are set to trigger heavy to extremely heavy downpours across eastern, northern, and southern states, with the weather office warning of flash flood risks in low-lying parts of Odisha, West Bengal, and Jharkhand.

item.title: NEET-UG leak 2026: CBI chargesheet claims paper setting done at NTA's Okhla building; what key evidence did agency find?
item.description: NEET paper leak chargesheet: The probe agency cited data from the app used by Kulkarni’s residential society, including biometric records of students attending his special coaching classes, in its 28 July charge sheet against the 13 accused filed before a special CBI court.

item.title: ‘Mecca Joint Defence Agreement’: India ‘closely following’ Pakistan-Saudi-Turkey pact, says MEA
item.description: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and Turkey signed the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement in Mecca on Friday, pledging closer military cooperation amid growing security concerns in the Middle East.

item.title: Honour killing Uttar Pradesh: Father drowns daughter to death over pregnancy outside marriage
item.description: A 52-year-old man was arrested for allegedly drowning his 18-year-old pregnant daughter in Agra. Fearing social stigma, he allegedly conspired with a relative, also arrested.&nbsp;

item.title: As Thailand evaluates BrahMos, here's a look at the countries buying or seeking India's flagship missile
item.description: Thailand has emerged as the latest country evaluating India's BrahMos missile, joining the Philippines, Vietnam and Indonesia. Reports also suggest interest from the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Brazil and Chile as New Delhi expands its defence exports.

item.title: Centre steps up leptospirosis surveillance, preparedness
item.description: Leptospirosis can progress rapidly to multi-organ failure, jaundice, internal bleeding and even death if left untreated.

item.title: TN CM Vijay's wife Sangeetha withdraws divorce petition
item.description: Sangeetha appeared before the court through video-conferencing when her plea was taken up, and she submitted the reasons for not pursuing her case

item.title: Pakistan PM Shehbaz Sharif, Asim Munir perform Umrah at Makkah's Grand Mosque during Saudi Arabia visit: Video
item.description: Pakistan's Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, along with a key delegation, offered Umrah at Makkah's Grand Mosque on August 7 during his trip to Saudi Arabia. Pakistan’s Foreign Office has termed the visit another move towards deepening the longstanding Islamabad-Riyadh relationship

item.title: Iran-Oman deal to fully open Strait of Hormuz? ‘It represents a new model’ — What the framework proposes
item.description: Iran-Oman deal on Strait of Hormuz: The two countries are finalizing a deal to ease disruption in the strait. Tehran says both sides have agreed on corridor coordinates, with a joint statement expected soon.
